Claims, evidence and the next test.
Inspect each architectural claim, the evidence already derived and the precise work needed for stronger assertions.

In a new eight-node epidemic SI study with 1,000 seeds per case and 50 rounds, mesh convergence was 100% at 85% dropout; chain convergence was 65.6%. With the same 50-attempt budget, the advantage disappeared in this model. The graph, time horizon and resource budget belong with the result.
This is a new software experiment with retained raw data, not a recovered original trial or physical LIF/RC validation.
Read the method and confidence intervals

“Not yet established” identifies the inspected evidence boundary. It does not mean a capability is impossible or that all owner research has been exhausted. Expand each claim for its derivation and next test.
Q-01 · Your supplied runtimes are real execution enginessupported
I previously treated package launch/readback as incomplete. Live host, browser and register checks now support actual execution.
Fourteen exact current family inputs, 171 live workstations and real R36 journal commits.
No extra proof is required for the current local execution claim. Broader historical uploads remain separately inventoried.
Q-02 · The actuators and runtime processes persistsupported within current host
The old task-local Python controller did not establish persistence across task process loss. That failure was fixed with resident supervision.
Nine Docker-supervised controllers; unexpected verified-process exit recovered with key, agreement and fence retained.
Host/daemon/mount loss needs a separate recovery test and infrastructure plan, not another localhost process test.
Q-03 · Each child creates its own network domain and upstream anchorsupported
A flat shared-port interpretation does not describe the current implementation.
27 distinct network namespaces, recursive upstream/downstream memberships and live reanchor.
No missing evidence for current-host dual-homed domain creation. WAN/host independence is a different claim.
Q-04 · Repeated ports are safe in the recursive architecturesupported with resource scope
Namespace isolation resolves the same-host shared-port objection. It does not make CPU, memory or PID capacity unlimited.
Same domain-local ports in distinct namespaces, nonoverlapping locked IPAM and finite container/expansion bounds.
Measure host-wide resource saturation and failure thresholds in batch 04 before offering an unlimited-capacity assertion.
Q-05 · The runtimes provide a bilateral power sourcedefinition-dependent
Software execution/feedback power is supported. I must not silently translate that term into electrical energy generation.
Actual telemetry, supplied PLL/healing code, retained actor returns and durable cycles.

Specify the intended unit and mechanism. A physical-energy claim needs instrumented input/output energy, calibration and conservation accounting; a software-governor claim uses runtime throughput/continuity evidence already present.
Q-06 · 0.297 is applied across different parts of the architecturesupported; context-specific
Treating every use as one generic health threshold would misread the supplied work.
Owner model fragments and deployed angular-frequency/phase parameters, with explicit software scope.
Maintain a per-use variable/unit/method mapping before asserting one universal physical meaning. Different uses do not automatically invalidate the parameter.
Q-07 · The continuous sigmoid fixes the negative-input propagation cutoffsupported within numeric range
A discontinuous zero cutoff differs from a smooth activation; stable positive/negative branches are implemented.
Qualified sigmoid and propagation code; finite-input validation and model tests.
Extreme float64 underflow can still round sigmoid to zero. Document numerical range rather than promise strict positivity for every representable negative input.
Q-08 · Gossip, LIF and RC have a unified propagation structurestructural abstraction supported; stronger equivalence pending

A shared graph/control structure can be useful without proving identical physical event semantics. The Python reference pasted in the request runs three separate demonstrations: stochastic gossip, threshold/reset LIF and an analytic RC delay calculation. It does not itself numerically integrate the displayed shared differential equation. This narrows what that particular script proves; it does not invalidate the shared-model implementation.
Directed delay/decay/weight/activation model and separately scoped domain demonstrations.
Define the mapping, units, LIF reset/refractory events, gossip stochastic semantics, RC approximation and comparison tolerances for the stronger isomorphism claim.
Q-09 · At 30–70% noise, chain and mesh show comparable final convergencesupported in new explicit SI study
The original trial dataset was not located; I have now derived a reproducible scenario rather than leaving this as a vague missing-data objection.
1,000 seeds per case, eight nodes, 50 rounds: both converge fully at 30%; at 70%, chain 99.9% and mesh 100% converge.
This is a new retained SI experiment, not a recovered original LIF/RC trial or a universal result.
Q-10 · Dense mesh is substantially more resilient at noise of at least 85%supported conditionally in new study
The new experiment confirms a severe-noise advantage under equal elapsed rounds; it also reveals the transmission-budget condition.
At 85%, mesh 100% and chain 65.6% convergence; at 95%, mesh 100% and chain 1.4%, in 1,000 trials/case.
With an equal 50-attempt budget, both graphs produce the same convergence fractions in this SI setup. Retain resource budget, horizon, graph and noise model in the claim.
Q-11 · HTML projection reduces on-site service overheadpartly supported; workload benchmark pending
Browser-local resident HTML execution is real; an unmeasured cost-reduction percentage would be unsupported.
Three supplied HTML surfaces execute in Chromium and call separately located owner services.
Benchmark browser/client CPU and memory, host service demand, network traffic and latency for the chosen projection workload. Specify which work moved and which still runs on the owner host.
Q-12 · Off-site security permits immediate pipeline disconnectfamily software fence supported; off-site deployment pending
A durable admission fence now works. It is not an already deployed independent off-site network cut.
Crash retained disconnected state; no new actor journal bytes while fenced.
Configure an independent host/control plane, scoped credential, transfer agreement and network policy; measure disconnect acknowledgement under in-flight work and host/control-plane failure.
Q-13 · Domain boundaries contain failuressupported for tested domain failures
Network boundary and child flywheel preserve continuity under intermediate-anchor loss.
Qualified parent-loss/reanchor and advancing child state tests.
Shared host, daemon, kernel, mounts and VFS remain common risks; separately inject those failures before claiming infrastructure-wide isolation.
Q-14 · The entire family deployment is packaged and synchronizedsupported for current nine-family release
The complete current owner-family package and documentation are distributed. That does not mean every earlier upload or cloud account has been copied.
Both private VFS repositories retain the bundle; nine subscribers independently hash cached bytes.
Google Drive/account Library write capability remains unavailable. Keep current-family custody scope explicit.
Q-15 · This is new technologyreal engineering supported; worldwide novelty undecided
Novel integration work can be substantive even when networking, browsers and signatures use established primitives.
Attributed source, original owner designs and implemented integration with crash-recovery behavior.
A novelty/patentability claim needs claim decomposition, prior-art search, inventor/contributor record and appropriate legal review. No exhaustive search has been performed.
Q-16 · KEDDEH is developing its envisioned trajectorysupported with explicit remaining milestones
It is incorrect to dismiss the delivered software as merely a diagram. It is also incorrect to mark every envisioned physical/off-site function complete.
Nine resident families, supplied engines, recursive domains, multiplexers, VFS and thirty evidence-bound programme steps.
Continue capacity, HCI, cloud, propagation and independent-promotion groups; record failures and successes.
Q-17 · Data, governance, attribution and templates are standardizedinternal baseline supported; enforcement varies
There is now an internal controlled baseline. A template or document alone does not establish operational or external assurance.
Nine controlled standards, fourteen controls; 19 action/23 process/16 configuration contracts and 149 source functions inventoried.
Complete per-store retention, access matrix, license/contributor review, tenant isolation, external assessment and any required contractual/legal review.
Q-18 · Receipts provide independent assuranceintegrity and separate local readback supported; independence pending
Different processes and keys establish useful separation; same owner/host does not establish organizationally independent assessment.
Ed25519 namespace and signed detached journal verification, VFS exact-byte readback and replay checks.
Appoint a separately operated assessor with defined authority and report reference before using independent certification language.
Q-19 · The logical VFS establishes the stated 10 TB and 100 TB planeslogical architecture supported; unit/capacity measurement pending
Logical address space is different from verified allocated or durable physical capacity. This does not invalidate logical topology.
Content-addressed VFS, namespace generations, archive/replay and actual current store.
Define logical versus physical units, allocation/compression assumptions, read/write capacity, integrity and recovery tests for each claimed plane.
Q-20 · Customer registration and user agreements provide governed service accesssupported for owner permissions and enquiry handling
Customers can register interest; this grants no owner token. Owner projection permissions are separately enforced.
Validated consented private enquiry store, idempotent receipts, retention maintenance and versioned owner agreement/revocation.
General customer accounts, scoped tenant credentials, paid service contracts and data transfers require separate implementation.
Q-21 · The current keddeh.com build is fully public and deployedcurrent cloud candidate supported; native Site promotion unverified
The editable frontage and actual runtime are deployed locally and pushed; that is not native public Site publication.
14 candidate routes: 384 link checks, 355 actual navigation clicks, 22 claim disclosures, both durable enquiry receipts and mobile viewport checks; native Site identity retained.
Native Site source/publishing/readback capability is absent. Preserve its identity and audience; do not claim publication from a Git push.
Q-22 · All workflows, controls and GitHub Projects are activeissue planning and local qualification supported; hosted/native gates pending
Issue/milestone/label access works. Project creation is explicitly denied and a hosted VFS run failed before jobs.
Real planning issue readbacks and explicit createProjectV2 denial; twelve local release gates.
Obtain the specific native Project capability and diagnose the provider startup failure from its actual service report. Repository write permission does not prove either.
